testsuite.name: com.crush.mobile.ui.screens.projects.ProjectsContentTest

testcase.name: an empty registry explains what the list is for
the latest measured turn is shown in the row and home
the legacy workspace is not listed among Code projects
a trusted project says its configuration is approved
an internal project names the workspace folder it deletes
registry and import errors are both surfaced
the trust dialog renders the shared copy and confirms once
an imported row remove is confirmed named and cancel-safe
the active project is marked current by check word and semantics
populated rows carry label path identity and trust
import dispatches its host callback and a top-level screen has no back control
a project row opens a home with identity and both Code actions
